r7_recovery_contract.invariant: No public ConversationState HEAD/bookkeeping field is mutated until every same-generation pending marker/event in the recovery set has been parsed, digest/parent checked, and arranged into one exact non-ambiguous chain from the persisted HEAD/head_is_empty state.
precommit_rules: marker generation lower than persisted generation is stale cleanup residue and may be deleted without changing HEAD
marker generation higher than persisted generation fails closed
same-generation marker with no durable event is marker-before-event crash residue and may be deleted without changing HEAD
same-generation durable event must match marker parent and exact event digest
planning uses only local virtual leaf/head_is_empty/last_user_message_id values
exactly one marker may match each virtual HEAD step; ambiguity or unreachable residue fails closed with no HEAD mutation
after explicit empty HEAD, adopted tree event must be an explicit ROOT_PARENT_ID root
markerless event-log descendants are never inferred as active-branch intent
r7_recovery_contract.commit_rule: After the complete chain validates, persist one base-state snapshot containing final leaf_event_id, head_is_empty, last_user_message_id and persistence_generation+1. Then update in-memory fields without intermediate autosaves and only afterwards delete lower-generation markers.
r7_recovery_contract.crash_rule: If base-state commit wins but marker cleanup is lost, next restart sees lower-generation markers and performs cleanup only; it must not replay the HEAD transition.
r7_recovery_contract.existing_action_recovery: Preserve the existing unmatched executable ActionEvent recovery because it additionally synthesizes an explicit execution error/result boundary. The marker protocol addresses tree reachability and ordinary-event durability, not action-result semantics.
